name: synthetic-pi-wiki-v1
description: Invented facts for comparison only. Not user preferences, real credentials or production guidance.

documents.title: Access boundary
documents.summary: Listener scope and remote access policy.
documents.body:
# Access boundary
The synthetic service listens on loopback only. Remote users connect through an SSH tunnel. Opening a browser tab does not start a second agent.
See [Terminal lifetime](/concepts/terminal-lifetime.md).

documents.title: Terminal lifetime
documents.body:
# Terminal lifetime
Closing a browser tab disconnects its viewer. The tmux session and Pi process keep running. The synthetic session name is violet-workbench.
See [Session records](/concepts/session-records.md).

documents.title: Session records
documents.summary: Where conversation history survives a restart.
documents.body:
# Session records
Pi conversation history is saved in JSONL files. The synthetic history root is /srv/example/sessions. A session is not the wiki: a fresh session must retrieve durable knowledge from the shared vault.
See [Shared knowledge](/concepts/shared-knowledge.md).

documents.title: Shared knowledge
documents.summary: One durable vault used by separate conversations.
documents.body:
# Shared knowledge
Independent Pi sessions use the same explicit vault root, /srv/example/knowledge. Context windows are separate. Saving a cited insight to disk makes it available to a future session, but it still has to search and read the page.
See [Child context](/concepts/child-context.md).

documents.title: Child context
documents.summary: Tool and root configuration for delegated work.
documents.body:
# Child context
A child agent does not automatically inherit its parent's wiki tools. Pass the shared vault root and wiki tools explicitly. A child with no recall tool cannot query the vault through that tool.
See [Shared knowledge](/concepts/shared-knowledge.md).

documents.title: Write coordination
documents.summary: Avoiding conflicts between simultaneous wiki writers.
documents.body:
# Write coordination
The synthetic workflow allows multiple readers and one curator writer. Workers submit separate proposal files. Replacing a metadata file atomically prevents partial JSON reads, but does not merge edits to the same page.
See [Shared knowledge](/concepts/shared-knowledge.md).

documents.title: Search methods
documents.summary: Literal search, semantic retrieval and page expansion.
documents.body:
# Search methods
BM25 scores matching terms in full text. Embeddings can retrieve paraphrases with no shared words. Returning links before expanding page content saves context, but does not itself improve candidate recall.
See [Evidence trails](/concepts/evidence-trails.md).

documents.title: Evidence trails
documents.summary: Citations that resolve to original source evidence.
documents.body:
# Evidence trails
Every durable claim cites a stable source ID and a page or section. Raw source revisions are immutable. A summary can omit a condition, so check the source before changing a decision.
See [Retention rule](/concepts/retention-rule.md).

documents.title: Old search decision
documents.body:
# Old search decision
On January 10 the synthetic project chose RemoteVector for semantic retrieval. This decision is superseded by [Current search decision](/decisions/search-current.md). Do not present RemoteVector as the current choice.

documents.title: Current search decision
documents.summary: Active local-provider decision and its predecessor.
documents.body:
# Current search decision
On February 20 the synthetic project replaced RemoteVector with LocalVector. LocalVector is the current semantic retrieval provider. This supersedes [Old search decision](/decisions/search-old.md). The reversal keeps private documents on the host.

documents.title: Recovery check
documents.body:
# Recovery check
A full backup includes pages, immutable raw packets and events.jsonl. Generated indexes can be rebuilt. After restoring, query the sentinel paper-crane-731 and check its source citation.
See [Evidence trails](/concepts/evidence-trails.md).

documents.title: Routing
documents.summary: Model requests through a local proxy.
documents.body:
# Routing
The synthetic proxy is llama-swap. It routes requests to the configured backend. It does not store the wiki or merge different agent context windows.
See [Shared knowledge](/concepts/shared-knowledge.md).

documents.title: Cache gap
documents.summary: A diagnosed loss of retrieval freshness.
documents.body:
# Cache gap
Incident FALCON-47 was caused by a stale registry after a page rename. Rebuilding metadata restored visibility. The raw source was intact; the problem was indexing, not failed capture.
See [Recovery check](/concepts/recovery-check.md).

documents.title: Duplicate ingest
documents.summary: Stable identities for repeated source captures.
documents.body:
# Duplicate ingest
In the synthetic workflow a canonical URL and content hash identify repeated imports. A changed source gets a new immutable revision. Reusing a title alone is not a safe deduplication key.
See [Evidence trails](/concepts/evidence-trails.md).

documents.title: Retention rule
documents.body:
# Retention rule
The synthetic purge procedure removes an excluded source and derived claims from the active corpus. Rebuild the search index after deletion so stale hits do not retain removed text. A Git history copy also needs a separate review.
See [Evidence trails](/concepts/evidence-trails.md).

documents.title: Мова нотаток
documents.body:
# Мова нотаток
Українські нотатки зберігають у UTF-8. Під час стискання не можна втрачати умови та заперечення. Назва вигаданого контрольного запису: синій ліхтар.
See [Evidence trails](/concepts/evidence-trails.md).

documents.title: Browser cache
documents.body:
# Browser cache
Browsers cache static style sheets. A hard reload can refresh an old CSS file. Browser caching is unrelated to the wiki registry.

documents.title: Terminal colors
documents.body:
# Terminal colors
A terminal theme controls foreground and background colors. A violet theme is a visual choice, not a session storage path.

documents.title: Vector artwork
documents.body:
# Vector artwork
Vector artwork consists of paths and control points. It is not a provider of semantic document embeddings.

documents.title: SSH key rotation
documents.body:
# SSH key rotation
An SSH key authenticates an administrator. This fixture does not specify a key rotation schedule or any real private key.

documents.title: Agent avatar
documents.body:
# Agent avatar
A child agent avatar has a different icon. Icons do not grant tools or filesystem permissions.

documents.title: Database tuning
documents.body:
# Database tuning
A database cache can reduce repeated disk reads. This page does not choose a search provider or define a wiki write policy.

documents.title: Meeting notes
documents.body:
# Meeting notes
The team scheduled a discussion about source citations and restore procedures. No decisions were made at this meeting.

documents.title: Search interface
documents.body:
# Search interface
The search box has rounded corners. Its visual appearance does not change which documents are retrieved.
